title: Close request (POST <BASE>/close)
description: Sent at session end (e.g. a SessionEnd hook). Pauses or closes the worksite and releases everyone waiting on it. The server answers an empty 200; the response is not used (small event budget). Dormancy takes over for clients that never send this (PROTOCOL.md §7).

sessionRef.description: Accepted alias for session_id (reference implementations read sessionRef ?? session_id).

reason.description: OPTIONAL outcome or free-text reason, e.g. merged | abandoned | done.
